checkpoints.code: for (unsigned j= 0; j < ncmds; ptr = (Mach_command const *)(ptr->cmdsize + (char const *)ptr), ++j) {
checkpoints.note: Root cause fixed by commit `a49d023bd04c585ac4c342c90d214c9aef2c8b08`. The loop is re-entered solely while `j < ncmds`; vulnerable code has no `headway < (int)sizeof(Mach_command)` check before the loop body dereferences `ptr`, so a file can advertise more commands than there are complete `Mach_command` prefixes in the `sizeofcmds` buffer.
